title: A Berry for the Baker
objectiveText: Pick berries from the berry bush for Marla the Baker.
offerLines: Oh, hello little Reeble! I'm baking a pie, but I've run clean out of berries.
Would you be a dear and pick some from the berry bush for me?
activeLines: The berry bush is just down the lane — you can't miss it.
Pick the ripest ones! My pie deserves nothing less.
completeLines: Oh, these are perfect! You have a fine eye for berries.
Thank you, little Reeble — this pie will be the talk of the village!
